findings.issue: Section 4 quotes only the ex-shift hybrid gap (~2%) and omits the incl-shift gap (~4%) plus the measured SetFit shift collapse, overstating router robustness for deployment trust.
findings.location: Section 4 System Architecture — 'routed hybrid lands within about 2 points of the LLM outside shift'
findings.missing_substance: interim-setfit-vs-llm-intent-with-uncertainty-routing holds: M=10+Haiku 0.696 avg incl-OADP vs 0.737 ex-OADP against native 0.736/0.760 (gap ~2% ex-shift, ~4% incl-shift); ADP->OADP SetFit drop ~15% vs smaller LLM drop; OOS-recall Mistral-L 0.641 / Haiku 0.601 / SNA 0.489 / baseline SetFit 0.378; routed fraction 0.32-0.43 at 0.748-1.005s vs 2.345s native.

findings.issue: Router is described as '10-pass dropout' contesting MaxProb but the implementable routing rule, M ablation, and mandatory baseline contest are dropped, leaving the router untunable.
findings.location: Section 4 System Architecture — 'Full-layer 10-pass dropout therefore routes only if it beats temperature-scaled MaxProb on risk-coverage area'
findings.missing_substance: interim-setfit-vs-llm-intent-with-uncertainty-routing holds Arora App A.2 rule (M stochastic forwards, uncertain iff distinct argmax >1 OR <M/2, dropout 0.1, M=10 with M=5 capturing most gain and M=10->20 flat, batched MC cuts latency); mandatory MaxProb+temperature baseline picked by AURC/refinement on IID-held-out AND temporal-held-out; taxonomy guardrails (masked Label-xx, explicit OOS, merge pair with >15% cross-confusion) and Loukas/Wang guards (>5/class fine-tune rule, representative>random demos, inverted-U more-demos-hurts-OOD, 8.49% format failures at N=150).
findings.suggested_fix: Insert the exact routing predicate, M/dropout settings, M-ablation expectation, and the MaxProb+temp AURC contest as the promotion gate; add one-line taxonomy controls (masked names, 15% merge rule, RAG top-K 5-10 only for routed queries).

findings.issue: Escalation section reduces the calibrator-vs-floor debate to 'double-digit gains' and omits the numbers, the refinement correction, and the ranking-vs-scaling distinction that justify the MaxProb floor.
findings.location: Section 6 Escalation Policy — 'A published confidence-plus-difficulty calibrator reports double-digit risk-coverage gains'
findings.missing_substance: interim-escalation-calibration-under-shift-depth-investigation holds: Varshney-2020 gains (15.81% IID/5.64% OOD NLI, 6.19% IID/13.9% OOD dup) vs Varshney-2022 non-dominance across 17 sets; Gu & Hopkins refinement isolating ranking (many AURC wins vanish); monotone temperature/Platt rescales but does not reorder so it fixes ECE not AURC; Whitehead 6.8%->16.3% (2.4x) at 1% risk with vanilla <8% coverage; ReCoVERR 94%-correct-abstained, +20pp coverage/+25-30% recall with 1-4pp overshoot at strict 10%; Phi_c scoring (+1 correct/-c incorrect/0 abstain, Phi_1) and AUGRC GRC(c)=risk+gamma*(1-c) gamma 0.5; split-conformal band 1-alpha<=P<=1-alpha+1/(n+1) with exchangeability disclaimed.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore exact gain numbers with IID/OOD split, add one sentence that temperature improves interpretability without repairing ranking (cite refinement/AURC split), define Phi_1 and AUGRC formula, and state the conformal interval plus why brand drift voids it.

findings.issue: Gold-certification gate is weakened to a global alpha plus a <0.60 floor, dropping the per-label, ordinal, escalation, prevalence, confidence, and compliance-vs-wellformedness controls the interim requires to block headlines.
findings.location: Section 7 Evaluation Baselines and the LLM Judge — 'Ship gold only at alpha at or above 0.80 with lower bound at or above 0.70 and no label under 0.60'
findings.missing_substance: interim-golden-set-adjudication-and-agreement-gate holds: per-label alpha >=0.70 (not just none<0.60) plus Gwet AC1 reported when label rarer than ~10%; ordinal reply-quality quad-weighted kappa + ordinal alpha >=0.70 with Spearman >=0.70; escalation kappa >=0.70 plus F1 with prevalence disclosed; confidence 1-5 per label to catch unanimous-but-uncertain; honeypots 3-10% rotating with ~90% block, static-honeypot leak warning, and gold=compliance vs disagreement-audit=wellformedness distinction; 0.667-0.80 tentative requires slice re-annotation not headline quoting.
findings.suggested_fix: Reinstate the three numeric sub-gates (per-label >=0.70, ordinal >=0.70+Spearman, escalation >=0.70+F1), add Gwet AC1 for rare labels and confidence 1-5, and specify honeypot rate/block plus mandatory disagreement-distribution audit alongside gold compliance.

findings.issue: Hybrid retrieval is recommended as 'cold-start fusion then tuned weight' without the fusion arithmetic, priors, sample threshold, or coupling warning, inviting hand-tuned alpha=0.5.
findings.location: Section 5 Retrieval and Reply Generation — 'Fuse 100 candidates per arm with cold-start fusion, then sweep to a tuned single weight'
findings.missing_substance: interim-hybrid-retrieval-payoff holds: RRF score(d)=sum 1/(k+rank) k=60 convention sidestepping BM25-vs-cosine scale; weighted score=alpha*dense_norm+(1-alpha)*sparse_norm with normalization second-order but depth-coupled (log depth with alpha); domain priors alpha~0.3 sparse-heavy for identifier traffic / 0.7-0.8 conversational / 0.5-0.6 balanced; migrate RRF->weighted only after >=40 relevance pairs via alpha-sweep 0-1; WANDS naive 0.7068 vs 0.6983/0.6953 (+~1.2%) vs tuned+boost 0.7497 (+7.4%), tiered +7.5% vs plain +1.3%; BM25 k1 0.5-0.8 for short docs with preserved @/#/digits/hyphens.
findings.suggested_fix: Insert both fusion equations with k=60, the alpha priors and >=40-pair migration rule, the depth-logging warning, k1 range, and the WANDS naive-vs-tuned contrast to justify the 5-point identifier gate.

findings.issue: Judge section states swap harm and low-agreement tilt qualitatively but drops the magnitudes, the DBG definition, and the continuous-scoring/re-audit machinery needed to enforce the cage.
findings.location: Section 7 Evaluation Baselines and the LLM Judge — 'Pairwise order-swap flips of about a third' and 'Chain-of-thought form-filling reaches mid-0.50s rank correlation'
findings.missing_substance: caged-judge-protocol-for-grounded-replies-interim-locus-caged-judge holds: swap helps +4.7pp natural but hurts -3 to -13pp adversarial (3 Holm-Bonferroni-significant) by discarding correct verdicts as ties, ties 32.8%->12.5% with stronger prompts; position <=0.04 vs style 0.10-0.76 (Pro 0.76/Flash 0.72/Claude 0.68/Llama 0.40/GPT-4o 0.10, humans 57% vs judges 73-97%); verbosity heterogeneous (+0.24-0.44 Llama/Pro/Flash, -0.12 Claude, -0.04 GPT-4o); self-preference GPT-4 0.52 (0.945 vs 0.425, DP 0.749) with DBG=own-minus-gold (naive own-vs-other conflates quality); G-Eval pro-LLM tilt even where human alpha=0.07; prob-weighted score=sum p(si)*si n=20 with Kendall tie-inflation warning; 100-300-pair held-out re-audit with drop<75% rotation; S8 Flash 71.0% kappa 0.549 $0.001/eval.
findings.suggested_fix: Add swap harm range and tie-rate mechanism to justify pointwise-for-gold/pairwise-only-close-call; define DBG as own-minus-gold with <0.10 gate; require per-judge length-Spearman audit (no fixed direction assumed); state continuous-scoring formula and re-audit schedule; cite alpha=0.07 tilt as reason to distrust judges where humans disagree (sarcasm slice).
